scenarios.theme: A report outage breaks healthy account reads. What do you isolate?
scenarios.assumptions: Both call paths share one executor and all its workers wait on reports. What will you do and why?
scenarios.limitations: Constructed production interview prompt; exact frequency, ranking and company attribution are unverified.

concept-specificity.rationale: Applies Bulkhead Pattern to report stall.

distinctness.rationale: Separate constraint/decision: A report outage breaks healthy account reads. What do you isolate?

production-prompt.rationale: Prompt states a production failure or workload bound and asks for a justified response.

direct-answer.rationale: Reviewed action: Give report work a bounded dependency budget and, if needed, a separate supported executor/queue, preserving account capacity

decision-costs.rationale: Reviewed cost/alternative: Reserved workers cost memory and may idle

follow-up.rationale: Reviewed trap: A semaphore can suffice if it protects the actual resource; a separate queue alone cannot free the already blocked shared executor.

evidence.rationale: Primary support mapped to bulkhead, r4jbulkhead; interview frequency is not claimed.

full-delivery.rationale: Three labeled parts are self-contained; native disclosure and host confidence integration use stable keys.
